scheme_name: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Green Certification
overview: The Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Green Certification is a Ministry of MSME initiative to create awareness among MSMEs about ZED practices, motivate them to adopt zero-defect and zero-environmental-impact manufacturing, and incentivize certification through financial subsidies and recognition. The scheme aims to enhance MSME competitiveness, sustainability, and global market readiness by promoting quality, productivity, energy efficiency, and environmental consciousness. It operates in two phases: Phase 1 for manufacturing MSMEs with UDYAM registration, and Phase 2 for service sector MSMEs. The scheme provides graded incentives, handholding support, and access to financial assistance for certification and related activities.
objectives: Encourage and enable MSMEs for manufacturing of quality products using latest technology, tools & to constantly upgrade their processes for achievement of high quality and high productivity with the least effect on the environment
Develop an Ecosystem for ZED Manufacturing in MSMEs, for enhancing competitiveness and enabling exports
Promote adoption of ZED practices and recognising the efforts of successful MSMEs
Encourage MSMEs to achieve higher ZED Certification levels through graded incentives
Increase public awareness on demanding Zero Defect and Zero Effect products through the MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification
Identify areas to improve upon, thereby assisting the Government in policy decisions and investment prioritization
eligibility: All MSMEs registered with the UDYAM registration portal (of the MoMSME) will be eligible to participate in MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification and avail related benefits/incentives. Any number of Units registered under one Udyam Registration can apply for subsidy under this Scheme. Each Unit (under one Udyam Registration) will need to apply for Certification separately to avail subsidy/benefits/incentives.
benefits: Benefits include Joining reward of Rs. 10,000/- for ZED Certification, free MSME KAWACH (WASH Certification) for ZED registered MSMEs, financial assistance/subsidy for certification cost (80% for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium Enterprises), additional 10% subsidy for Women/SC/ST Entrepreneurs or MSMEs in NER/Himalayan/LWE/Island territories/aspirational districts, additional 5% subsidy for MSMEs part of SFURTI or MSE-CDP, subsidy for surveillance assessment (Silver: Rs. 10,000, Gold: Rs. 20,000) at same subsidy rates, handholding support up to Rs. 5 Lakhs (Rs. 2 Lakhs for consultancy, Rs. 3 Lakhs for technology upgradation) with subsidies as per MSME size, and financial assistance for Testing/System/Product Certification up to 75% of cost with ceiling of Rs. 50,000/-.
financial_support: Financial assistance includes: Joining reward of Rs. 10,000/- (deductible from certification cost); subsidy on certification cost: Micro Enterprises 80%, Small Enterprises 60%, Medium Enterprises 50%; additional 10% subsidy for Women/SC/ST Entrepreneurs or MSMEs in NER/Himalayan/LWE/Island territories/aspirational districts; additional 5% subsidy for MSMEs in SFURTI or MSE-CDP; 100% subsidy for Women-owned MSMEs (as per Addendum 2023); subsidy for surveillance assessment (Silver: Rs. 10,000, Gold: Rs. 20,000) at same MSME-size-based rates; handholding support up to Rs. 5 Lakhs (Rs. 2 Lakhs for consultancy, Rs. 3 Lakhs for technology upgradation) with subsidies as per MSME size; and financial assistance for Testing/System/Product Certification up to 75% of cost with maximum ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per certification.
application_process: 1. Visit the official ZED portal at https://zed.msme.gov.in/ 2. Enter valid Udyam Registration Number and associated mobile number for validation 3. Provide valid Email ID and confirm it 4. Receive ZED ID, Password, and ZED Pledge Certificate via email 5. Login using credentials sent to email 6. Take the ZED Pledge via dashboard 7. Apply for desired ZED Certification Level (Bronze, Silver, Gold) 8. Download ZED MSME mobile app from Play Store 9. Provide GST and TAN numbers if applicable 10. Opt to avail Joining Reward of Rs. 10,000/- (deducted from certification cost) 11. Select payment option and make online payment for MSME contribution 12. Capture MSME Representative Selfie and Site Exterior Photographs 13. Upload Basic Information and Documents 14. Submit for assessment 15. Assessor verifies information and documents 16. Address any non-conformances raised within stipulated time 17. Upon successful verification, certificate and report are issued via email and dashboard.
required_documents: Mobile Number associated with Udyam Registration
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
contact_details: Email: zed.support@qcin.org | Helpline: Not explicitly provided in evidence
caveats: ZED Registration is Free of Cost and paperless. No online or offline agency, institution, assessor, or consultant is authorised to charge any fee or money for registration.
The Fee for Certification or Handholding (Consultancy) is prescribed in the scheme guidelines. Payment if any, shall be made only through online mode as defined in the user manuals.
The joining reward of Rs. 10,000/- is valid only for 1 year after taking the ZED Pledge.
The subsidy will be applicable on only one Testing OR one Quality OR one Product Certification after achieving this Level (as per original guidelines; amended to prospective basis in 2024).
MSMEs that upgrade from Silver to Gold Certification during the certification cycle will not require to undergo Surveillance Assessments for the previous level.
The Certification shall be suspended/withdrawn if the MSME fails to apply for or successfully complete Surveillance Assessments.
In case of withdrawal, the MSME will have to apply fresh by paying the entire Assessment/Certification Fee.
